visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand in a well-lit gym with rows of dumbbells. One man has a large black afro, wearing a white tank top and colorful shorts, holding small dumbbells. The other man is highly muscular, wearing a gray tank top. The muscular man gestures while speaking. (2) The camera switches between close-up shots of the two men's faces. The man with the afro looks annoyed and defiant, while the muscular man maintains a serious, almost condescending expression. (3) Back in a medium shot, the man with the afro speaks animatedly, pointing to himself and his clothes. He gestures widely, appearing to argue about his presence in the gym. (4) A third man with reddish-brown hair and a leaner build, wearing a black sleeveless shirt, is seen sitting on a gym machine. He looks towards the first two and joins the conversation. (5) The man with the afro and the third man engage in a tense verbal exchange. The man with the afro points aggressively. He then turns away briefly, returns to strike a bodybuilding pose, and continues talking. (6) The muscular man and the third man speak to each other more calmly. The man with the afro is briefly out of the central focus. (7) In a hallway area of the gym near lockers, the third man suddenly approaches the man with the afro from behind and puts him in a tight chokehold/headlock. They struggle intensely. (8) The final scene transitions to a static promotional graphic featuring the third man holding a microphone on stage, with large text displaying song information and streaming platform availability.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A deep, authoritative male voice speaks over a low-volume, mid-tempo electronic background track. The voice has a calm but firm delivery. Ambient gym noise is minimal. (2) A second male voice with higher pitch and a more nasal, aggressive tone responds. The speech rate is faster, showing agitation. The BGM continues steadily. (3) The second male voice increases in volume and intensity, exhibiting a wider pitch range as he shouts. A subtle electronic drone underlies the dialogue. (4) A third male voice, smoother and more melodic with professional enunciation, interjects. He speaks with moderate conversational loudness. (5) The second and third male voices exchange words. The second voice remains high-arousal and loud. The third voice maintains a calm, dominant tone. (6) The third and first male voices speak briefly and calmly. The BGM track transitions into a slight riser effect. (7) A sudden percussive impact sound is heard, followed by the rustling of fabric and strained vocal grunts as two men struggle. The background music cuts out momentarily for dramatic effect. (8) High-quality pop ballad music swells. A male singing voice begins a powerful, emotive vocal performance. The audio is studio-mastered with rich reverb and clear instrumentals.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Conflict -> Escalation -> Plot Twist -> Musical Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic gym confrontation sketch to promote Andrew Tan's (陳勢安) new single 'Open Wound'. It features a humorous exchange between a muscular coach, a defiant man with an afro, and the artist himself, culminating in a dramatic 'struggle' that transitions into the music video snippet.
